text: The Moss Park and Ted Reeve Arena Nominating Panel will interview and recommend one candidate to Toronto and East York Community Council for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Appointed the following candidate to the Moss Park Arena Board, at pleasure of Toronto and East York Community Council, for a term of office ending on November 30, 2018, and until a successor is appointed: - David Alton 2. Directed that the confidential information contained in Confidential Attachments 1, 2 and 3 to the report (November 10, 2017) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Moss Park Arena Board.
